properties.name: The build-order decision's title now says it is settled, and names the order that was accepted
properties.rationale: The decision was accepted on @ajs's word on 2026-09-30, but its title still read "PROPOSED" and named the pre-acceptance order. The accepted order (in `chose`) moved the published vocabulary to step 0 and put algebra before the reader. A later reader trusts a title over a status field, so the stale title could have been taken as an open question or the wrong order. Found during a brainstorm over graph-primitives' ideas, and retitled on @ajs's word ("Yes, retitle it"). The revise-design skill was loaded only after the edit: the revision guard kept the old text, but this record of why was owed and is written now.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Retitled dec:priority-order-for-the-knowledge-graph-requirements-2026-09-28. It was "PROPOSED — … finish the edge readings on the one shared vocabulary first, then give the readings a reader, then extend them to every relationship". It is now "SETTLED 2026-09-30 — … one published, versioned vocabulary shared with StoryFlow first, then algebra on each reading, then a reader that runs rules from the declarations, then readings for every relationship". Status (accepted) and body unchanged. The prior title is kept in snap:epoch:preserved-on-write:dec:priority-order-for-the-knowledge-graph-requirements-2026-09-28.
